aggregate_policy: No new inferential statistics; plotted ratios and counts cross-checked against frozen session-1 analysis. Refer to the report for both sessions and confidence intervals.
annotation_policy: C is the first frozen worst_cx_count entry; S is the first frozen slowest_relative_cases entry. Nonpositive-axis annotations are retained in the caption/data but cannot be plotted.
eligibility: Both tools eligible across both sessions; displayed cell medians from session 1 only.
quality_formula: Q-Rust metric / baseline metric; >1 means Q-Rust more CX or deeper

rendering.determinism: Stable ordering, fixed styles/hash salt, no time metadata; byte identity is scoped to the same rendering dependencies.

speed_formula: baseline compile_ns / Q-Rust compile_ns; >1 means Q-Rust faster
zero_policy: No pseudocount or clipping. Zero numerator/denominator omitted from log axes and retained in data/counts.
